items.title: Phase 6: NPT long-trajectory stability fix (decoupled CSVR)
items.action: recon_done CONFIRMED the debt lead: _n_dof_thermostated (settle.py:1854-1894) sets remove_com=True (adjusts CSVR's target DOF count by -3) but _langevin_settle_vel (settle.py:2297-2324), the function settle_csvr's apply_fn actually calls for velocity constraints, has NO remove_linear_com_momentum parameter at all -- COM momentum is never actually removed anywhere in the CSVR path. Classic flying-ice-cube DOF/actual-removal mismatch. Fix: either wire real COM-momentum removal into the CSVR step (consistent with how settle_langevin's LFMiddle variant and settle_with_nhc already do it), or set remove_com=False to match reality (simpler, but leaves the physical coupling risk unaddressed -- not preferred). Recommend the former.
